articles.title: Political Tensions Flare After Minister Vijay Shah's Remarks on Colonel Sofia Qureshi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The political atmosphere in Madhya Pradesh turned tense after controversial remarks by state minister Vijay Shah, allegedly targeting Colonel Sofia Qureshi. In response, Congress workers staged a protest outside Shah's bungalow in Bhopal around 9:00 pm on Monday.

body.html:
The political atmosphere in Madhya Pradesh turned tense after controversial remarks by state minister Vijay Shah, allegedly targeting Colonel Sofia Qureshi. In response, Congress workers staged a protest outside Shah's bungalow in Bhopal around 9:00 pm on Monday.

Protesters threw black ink at the minister’s residence and raised slogans including “Bharat Mata Ki Jai” and “Vijay Shah Murdabad.” The protest follows mounting criticism of Shah’s statement, which has drawn condemnation from opposition leaders and civil society.

Security around the minister's bungalow has been tightened. The police are investigating the incident.

#update

The Madhya Pradesh High Court has directed the state government to register an FIR within four hours against Minister Vijay Kumar Shah for his controversial remarks about Colonel Sofia Qureshi. The order, issued by a division bench of Justices Atul Shridharan and Anuradha Shukla, set a strict 6 PM deadline on Wednesday, taking suo motu cognisance of the issue.

Despite Shah’s public apology on Tuesday, the controversy has intensified, drawing strong criticism from across the country. The Congress has demanded his immediate dismissal, with MP Congress chief Jitu Patwari warning of nationwide FIRs if action isn’t taken within 24 hours.

While the BJP has yet to issue an official response, sources suggest that the Mohan Yadav government may be considering Shah’s removal from the cabinet as early as Thursday. The situation remains tense, with public and political pressure mounting.

articles.title: India Rejects Trump’s “Trade for Peace” Remark on India-Pakistan Ceasefire
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Former U.S. President Donald Trump, commenting on the 2021 India-Pakistan ceasefire understanding, said: “Let us not trade nuclear missiles, let us trade goods,” adding that “India and Pakistan are getting along, and they can have a nice dinner.” He also remarked, “Millions of people...

body.html:
Former U.S. President Donald Trump, commenting on the 2021 India-Pakistan ceasefire understanding, said:
“Let us not trade nuclear missiles, let us trade goods,”
adding that “India and Pakistan are getting along, and they can have a nice dinner.”
He also remarked, “Millions of people could have died due to the conflict.”

Reacting to his claims, India firmly dismissed the suggestion that trade talks were linked to the ceasefire agreement.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal clarified: “The issue of trade did not come up in any of the talks between the U.S. and Indian sides” during discussions on tensions with Pakistan.

articles.title: Delhi: Traffic Cops Foil Armed Robbery, Nab Snatchers Despite Gunfire
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a display of exceptional bravery, two Delhi Traffic Police personnel foiled an armed robbery and apprehended two snatchers, despite one of them opening fire, officials said on Monday.

body.html:
In a display of exceptional bravery, two Delhi Traffic Police personnel foiled an armed robbery and apprehended two snatchers, despite one of them opening fire, officials said on Monday.

Sub-Inspector Sanjeev and Constable Rahul Nain of Shahdara Traffic Circle acted swiftly after a local resident alerted them about a gold chain snatching near Chetak Complex in Dilshad Garden. The suspects — Imran (26) from Ghaziabad and Warees (35) from Seemapuri — tried to flee on a high-powered motorcycle.

At Chintamani Chowk, Constable Nain kicked the fleeing bike, causing it to crash. As the duo attempted to escape, Imran fired at SI Sanjeev, who managed to overpower and arrest him. Warees, who also tried to shoot, was quickly disarmed by Nain.

Both accused were found carrying pistols and a total of 10 live bullets. Three stolen gold chains and the motorcycle used in the crime were recovered. Preliminary probe revealed Warees has over 40 prior cases.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bhopal: School Bus Runs Over Vehicles at Signal, Ayurvedic Intern Killed, Several Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic accident occurred on Monday at Roshanpura intersection in Bhopal, where a speeding school bus ran over multiple vehicles waiting at a red signal, killing a 30-year-old woman doctor and injuring at least four others.

body.html:
A tragic accident occurred on Monday at Roshanpura intersection in Bhopal, where a speeding school bus ran over multiple vehicles waiting at a red signal, killing a 30-year-old woman doctor and injuring at least four others.

The victim, Ayesha Khan, an ayurvedic doctor and intern at a local government hospital, was on her scooter when the bus hit and dragged her nearly 50 metres, killing her on the spot. She was wearing a helmet at the time. Ayesha, the only daughter of her family, was preparing for her wedding scheduled next month.

The bus, allegedly experiencing brake failure while descending the Roshanpura slope, first struck a motorcycle, then rammed into a taxi, three scooters, and two more motorcycles. One of the injured, 58-year-old Jai Prakash Lakhera from Nasrullaganj, remains in critical condition in a private hospital ICU. Others, including a cab driver and local workers, sustained varying injuries.

Police confirmed that the bus was over 15 years old and its registration had not been renewed. The vehicle has been seized. The driver and conductor fled the scene, but the bus owner has been taken into custody. A case has been registered and investigations are underway, including analysis of CCTV footage to confirm the cause—brake failure or driver negligence.

The incident caused heavy traffic congestion, which was later cleared by police with crane assistance.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh Minister Vijay Shah’s Controversial Remark Draws Attention
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Madhya Pradesh minister Vijay Shah has sparked controversy with a provocative statement, saying, "They had destroyed the vermilion of our sisters and daughters, those same people who were beaten up, we sent their sister to do the same to them." The remark is being interpreted as a...

body.html:
Madhya Pradesh minister Vijay Shah has sparked controversy with a provocative statement, saying, "They had destroyed the vermilion of our sisters and daughters, those same people who were beaten up, we sent their sister to do the same to them."

The remark is being interpreted as a reference to Muslim women serving in the Indian armed forces, including officers like Colonel Sofia Qureshi. The comment has raised concerns over communal undertones and the politicization of the armed forces.
